Grapploct

Fighting

Galar · Generation 8

Grapploct is a Fighting-type Jujitsu Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 1.6 m tall and weighs 39 kg. It evolves from Clobbopus. Its highest base stat is Attack (118), with a base stat total of 480.
